plainText:
(Japanese: 最高潮始動！サトシのマスターズトーナメント！！ The Climax Begins! 's Experience!!) is the 121st episode of Pokémon Journeys: The Series, and the 1,206th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on August 12, 2022.
 

==Plot==
The "Pokémon World Coronation Series News" covers the events of the Masters Eight Tournament so far, recapping the quarterfinals matches and providing an analysis of the semifinalists: , Diantha, , and . Following the in-depth analysis, the program lists the most shocking moments in Ash's World Coronation Series battles so far: the - combo that his used during his Ultra Class battle against Bea; his transforming 's into during his match against ; and the giant that his used to defeat Raihan's Gigantamax during his entrance battle.

The narrator, hosting a radio show, reads listener mail. The first letter is from Allister, which leads to a recap of how Ash first befriended his . The second letter comes from Wikstrom, leading to a recap of how Ash's evolved into during his battle with Rinto and his . The clip show ends with a storybook tale told by , telling how it woke up in a strange world after sleeping for a long time, but came to like the friends it made and things it could bite on in this new world.

==Trivia==
 " artwork for this episode]]
The narrator reads the title card for this episode.
Like the last clip show episode, no main character is physically present.
At three episodes, this episode marks the longest period Ash and Pikachu do not physically appear in the during their time as protagonists.
This makes it the third numbered episode in a row to not feature any main characters in person.
This is the first time that two have aired in the same series since Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl.
Also, at two weeks, this episode marks the shortest period between the airing of clip shows in a same series.
James, , Jessie, and narrate the preview for the next episode.
A special preview regarding the last semifinal match of the Masters Eight Tournament, Ash versus , was aired after the episode.
As a clip show, this episode was not dubbed into any other language, and was not aired anywhere outside of Japan and South Korea.
